description: An oil-style painting of an upright, ape-like hominin with a long torso and a brown, hairy body, walking across rocky ground with a small juvenile clinging to its side. A second dark, ape-like figure stands in the background behind it. The setting is dry scrub with thorny branches, dark broken rocks and dry grass under a dim, warm light. No text, border or frame is visible, and there are no tools or modern objects.
